Agent benefits: 
Streamline access to policy and process documents when creating a requisition.

Click on Procurement
Click on Purchase Requisitions
Choose the radio button that say Procurement policy Advisor
Click the button Ask Oracle
Select any of the suggested questions
Now ask the agent these prompts:
What is the procurement process for me? 
My computer is 2 years old. When can I a get a new one?
When is competitive bidding required?
What purchases require manager approval?

The Benefits Policy Advisor is your AI-powered digital assistant for company benefits, designed to deliver instant, reliable guidance on your eligibility, plan coverage, and compliance requirements. This digital worker takes the complexity out of benefits by quickly retrieving policy details, and explaining program rules—directly from your company’s own documentation.
Agent benefits:
Supports Compliance and Reduces Risk. Guides users through company-specific requirements, minimizing accidental non-compliance and eligibility mistakes.
Boosts Employee Satisfaction and Confidence. Empowers employees to make informed decisions about their benefits, increasing engagement and peace of mind.
Reduces Benefits Representative Administrative Burden. Automates routine benefits inquiries, allowing HR teams to focus on strategic benefits planning and personalized support.

runs.text: The Lead Advisor Agent is an AI-powered smart agent designed to help Sales Users interact directly with a lead’s context without navigating across multiple tabs or reports. By using Generative AI, the assistant intelligently responds to natural questions about a lead by analyzing a wide range of related data, including campaign history, recent activities, orchestration details, notes, and even custom fields. It can be launched via a smart action on any lead record. Whether you're preparing for a call, planning your next outreach, or qualifying a lead, the assistant helps you get precise answers instantly.
